about: Key templates for keyenergy.py: per mode, one weight per interval above the tonic, applied to the log pitch profile; and the preference for minor keys. Fitted by multinomial logistic regression on human-annotated tracks.
source: Beatport EDM Key Dataset, Angel Faraldo et al., https://zenodo.org/record/1101082
